answer.subgoal: Describe the stages of the 3D graphics pipeline, from object representation to scan conversion.
Explain the fundamental problem of rasterization: mapping continuous device coordinates to discrete pixel grids.
Compare methods for rendering points and lines, focusing on efficient, integer-based algorithms like Bresenham's.
Explain the importance of avoiding floating-point operations and define the problems of aliasing and anti-aliasing.
Analyze the increased computational complexity required to render realistic and dynamic scenes in virtual reality.
Describe how programmers utilize APIs and graphics libraries to abstract and implement the graphics pipeline.
Outline and describe the layered architecture of a complete virtual reality system.
Explain the need for parallelism in graphics operations and the role of the dedicated Graphics Processing Unit (GPU).
Describe the internal architecture of a GPU and how it processes the rendering pipeline using parallel data streams.
Detail how GPUs handle specialized tasks like surface texturing and hidden surface removal using the depth buffer.
Summarize the methods used by software libraries and GPUs to manage and reduce the computational complexity of VR rendering.
